# Resize Observer

> [!WARNING]
> This is a fork of [mcprp/resize-observer](https://github.com/mcprp/resize-observer) which is a fork of [juggle/resize-observer](https://github.com/juggle/resize-observer) which fixes [this issue](https://github.com/juggle/resize-observer/issues/144) with Nuxt >= 3.16 and Naive UI

This fork includes build files so it can be referenced as follows

```
"overrides": {
  "@juggle/resize-observer": "github:upclose-studio/resize-observer"
},
```
